description: Walk all SAAS_SERVICES, gather accounts via service:preset, cross-reference with the HR directory via reasoning, flag anomalies, write a markdown report. Per-service listing actions differ — set ACCOUNT_LIST_ACTION per engagement (e.g. 'list_users' for the service's preset).
_migration_note: v2: rewritten onto real ops only — file:read_json / service:preset / core:foreach / reasoning:analyze / file:json_parse / system:write_file. v1 used non-existent ops (service:directory_list, for_each, service:list_accounts, wisdom:cross_reference, wisdom:consolidate_inventory, media:render_markdown).

HR_SOURCE_PATH.description: JSON file with the active employee roster (exported from the HR system)

ACCOUNT_LIST_ACTION.description: Preset action name that lists accounts for each service (must exist in that service's preset)

on_error.remediation: Service unreachable or preset action missing — record as 'audit_failed' and continue.
Audit output was not parseable JSON; keep raw text and continue.
